_metadata.description: Deterministic remediation, scenario-auditor migration accounting, operator workbench, and Test Genie cutover.

requirements.title: Fix registry previews before writing
requirements.description: PreviewFix and ApplyFix are mounted through the shared validation RPC; preview is dry-run, apply requires explicit invocation, and every candidate reports rule_id, file_path, before, after, and applied status.

validation.notes: Implemented refs: api/internal/validation/fixes_test.go and api/handlers/validation/connect_handler_test.go. Assert dry-run no writes, apply writes expected patches, second apply is idempotent, empty previews report a clear message, and shared Fix RPC candidates expose rule_id/file_path/before/after/applied.

requirements.title: Only unambiguous repairs are auto-fixable
requirements.description: Auto fixes are limited to local mechanical edits; design-bearing changes such as endpoint versioning strategy, error envelope redesign, logging architecture, and context propagation remain manual with explicit reasons.

validation.notes: Implemented refs: .vrooli/maturity.json and api/internal/validation/fixes.go. Mechanical findings with deterministic fixers are marked implemented; lifecycle, health-schema, endpoint-versioning, context, logging, and timeout architecture changes are manual with explicit reasons.

requirements.title: Scenario-auditor API migration is parity-or-better
requirements.description: Each scenario-auditor API rule is accounted for as kept, redesigned, delegated to another provider, deferred, or rejected; migrated findings are compared against fixture scenarios before cutover.

validation.notes: Implemented refs: api/internal/migration/ledger_test.go plus docs/reference/scenario-auditor-api-migration.md. Assert every production legacy API rule file appears exactly once in the migration ledger, decisions are valid, and delegated boundary decisions remain explicit.

requirements.title: Endpoint inventory reconciliation is scoped to API Health
requirements.description: Registered handlers, endpoint descriptors, .vrooli/endpoints.json, CLI manifest mappings, and REST exception tags are reconciled for API readiness without taking over proto-health or cli-health ownership.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/validation/endpoint_inventory_test.go. Fixtures cover missing endpoint descriptors, stale endpoint manifests, REST exception tags, and explicit delegation to cli-health/proto-health.

requirements.title: Test Genie cutover preserves unrelated standards ownership
requirements.description: Test Genie can delegate API readiness to API Health while unrelated scenario-auditor standards remain owned by their replacement providers or legacy path until separately migrated.

validation.notes: Implemented ref: scenarios/test-genie/api/internal/orchestrator/phases/api_health_cutover_test.go. Asserts Test Genie registers a dedicated api phase backed by api-health over shared ScenarioValidationService, keeps standards backed by scenario-auditor for remaining non-API rules, orders api before standards, maps API findings into the existing standards source until a dedicated API source exists, and includes api-health in curated presets.

requirements.title: Fleet readiness view ranks API debt with as-of stamps
requirements.description: A future fleet view ranks scenarios by API-readiness debt, stale live-probe evidence, missing health-schema adoption, and fixable finding gaps, with every aggregate carrying captured-at/as-of metadata.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/fleet/fleet_test.go. Fixtures cover debt ordering, stale evidence, clean scenarios, and no-run/as-of handling.

requirements.title: Contract-aware probe packs are opt-in
requirements.description: Future representative endpoint probes are scenario-declared, safe by default, bounded by budgets, and never inferred from product APIs without an explicit probe-pack contract.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/probe/pack_test.go. Fixtures cover opt-in declaration, unsupported methods, timeout budgets, and disabled execution.

requirements.title: Cross-provider API facts are published only with consumers
requirements.description: API Health may publish normalized API-surface facts for neighboring providers only after a consumer contract exists, preventing speculative data products.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/facts/export_test.go. Assert exported fact schema stability and consumer-gated registration.

requirements.title: Operator workbench separates static findings from live evidence
requirements.description: The UI and human CLI reports group findings by capability, show live probe evidence as timestamped evidence rather than static debt, and provide fix previews without writing by default.

validation.notes: Implemented refs: ui/src/pages/ValidationPage.tsx, ui/src/api/validation.ts, ui/src/pages/ValidationPage.test.tsx, and ui/src/api/validation.test.ts. Assert provider-backed target summary, capability ladder, findings table, live probe evidence, execution-mode input, and dry-run fix preview candidates render without duplicating validation logic in the UI.
